lines.en: label chapthree6:
scene newsummerstuff1
And so a new day of a new cycle begins.
lines.zh: 于是,新循环里的新一天开始了。

lines.en: I walked to school with the same girls I always walk to school with (Ami included again this time) and, for the most part, it was like nothing ever changed.
lines.zh: 我和平时一起上学那些女孩一起走到学校(这次 Ami 也回来了),大体上,一切都像什么都没变过。

lines.en: Well, nothing apart from Ayane’s newfound hobby of poking Maya’s buttons every chance she gets.
lines.zh: 嗯,除了 Ayane 新添的爱好——逮着机会就去戳 Maya 的痛处。

lines.en: It’s all in good fun, though.
lines.zh: 不过都是闹着玩的。

lines.en: And to be frank, we kind of need it.
lines.zh: 而且说实话,我们还挺需要这个的。

lines.en: We almost lost someone the other night.
lines.zh: 那天晚上我们差点就失去了某个人。

lines.en: And no, I’m not just saying that because it’s Maya. I’d feel the same way about {i}anyone{/i} in the class if they came to school the next day without any memories.
lines.zh: 不,我这么说不只是因为那是 Maya。班里{i}任何一个人{/i},如果第二天来上学时什么都不记得了,我也会是同样的感受。

lines.en: Which I guess says a lot about how much everyone cared about {i}me{/i} in the beginning since...I went through that exact scenario.
lines.zh: 这大概很能说明一开始大家有多在乎我,因为……{i}我自己{/i}就经历过一模一样的情形。

lines.en: But again, that’s fine.
lines.zh: 不过再说一次,没关系。

lines.en: And again, it’s all in good fun.
lines.zh: 再说一次,这都是闹着玩的。

lines.en: I’m sure this summer will be filled with plenty of that.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定,这个夏天会充满很多这样的东西。

lines.en: : Oh, Arakawa. Good morning.
lines.zh: : 哦,Arakawa。早上好。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff2
: Hey, Wakana. You look slightly less miserable than you normally do this morning.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Wakana。你今天早上看起来比平时少了一点点惨。

lines.en: : You look about the same.
lines.zh: : 你看起来还是老样子。

lines.en: : Handsome and mysterious?
lines.zh: : 英俊又神秘?

lines.en: : I was thinking something more along the lines of a low-grade eldritch horror. One mostly harmless, but still displeasing to look at.
lines.zh: : 我想的大概更接近于某种低级的邪神恐怖。基本无害,可看着还是让人不舒服。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, fuck you too.
lines.zh: : 那也去你的。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff3
: Where’s your sidekick?
lines.zh: : 你的跟班呢?

lines.en: : Which one? I have like ten now.
lines.zh: : 哪个?我现在大概有十个了。

lines.en: : Imani. I wanted to invite her to the bar with Osako and me tonight.
lines.zh: : 我说的是 Imani。我想邀请她今晚跟我和 Osako 去酒吧。

lines.en: : Wait, really? I kind of figured she annoyed you based on the totally not racist “No Imani” sign she told me about yesterday.
lines.zh: : 等等,真的?我还以为她惹你烦呢——毕竟她昨天跟我说了那块「Imani 禁止入内」的牌子,那可一点都不种族歧视呢。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff4
: Oh. Wow. Yeah, I...really didn’t even think of that.
lines.zh: : 哦。哇。是啊,我……真的完全没往那方面想。

lines.en: : That’s not how she interpreted it, is it?
lines.zh: : 她不会是这么理解的吧?

lines.en: : I don’t think so. But still, why ban her from your room if you’re just going to go out looking for her instead of letting her come to you?
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是。不过话说回来,如果你反正要自己跑出去找她,那为什么不干脆让她来找你,还要把她挡在门外?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff5
: Because I know she is on the hunt for her own office and I refuse to give away the only location in this building that I can be comfortable in.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道她在找自己的办公室,而我不肯把这栋楼里唯一能让我舒坦的地方让出去。

lines.en: : So you sacrifice me instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你就拿我当祭品?

lines.en: : Is that not what friends are for? Sacrificing?
lines.zh: : 朋友不就是用来牺牲的吗?

lines.en: Today, I learned one more reason why Wakana doesn’t have many friends.
lines.zh: 今天,我又学到了一个 Wakana 朋友不多的理由。

lines.en: : No, Wakana. I don’t believe that’s what friends are for. But if I see her, I’ll tell her you’re looking for her.
lines.zh: : 不,Wakana。我不认为朋友是这么用的。不过要是我见到她,我会告诉她你在找她。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff3
: Thanks. We don’t really know many people around our age. Not to mention ones who actually seem to have a mostly good head on their shoulders.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我们这年纪的人认识得不多。更别说那些看起来脑子还基本清醒的了。

lines.en: : You have me. How come you never invite me to the bar?
lines.zh: : 你不是有我吗。怎么从来不邀请我去酒吧?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff5
: Who knows? Perhaps I think the testosterone would ruin the atmosphere?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢?也许是觉得睾酮会破坏气氛?

lines.en: : Besides, you’re older than us to begin with, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 再说,你本来就比我们大,不是吗?

lines.en: : Am I?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : I kind of just assumed that based on your demeanor and how fed up you are with life.
lines.zh: : 我只是根据你的举止、还有你对人生有多厌倦,就这么猜的。

lines.en: : If we judged people based on that alone, you’d likely be dead and buried right now.
lines.zh: : 要是光凭这个来判断人,你现在大概早就死了,而且已经埋了。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff6
: Ah...and how wonderful that would be.
lines.zh: : 啊……那该多好啊。

lines.en: : I thought you weren’t allowed to say things like that anymore after the incident?
lines.zh: : 我以为那件事之后,你就不许再说这种话了?

lines.en: : Are you referring to the one where you left me for dead and didn’t even stop by to say hello?
lines.zh: : 你是指你把我丢下等死、连路过打声招呼都不肯的那次?

lines.en: : Are we really not past that yet?
lines.zh: : 我们真的还没翻篇吗?

lines.en: : Imani never left me for dead, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : Imani 可从来没把我丢下等死,Arakawa。

lines.en: : Imani wasn’t even employed here yet.
lines.zh: : 那时候 Imani 还没在这儿上班呢。

lines.en: : Are you? Because I often find myself believing you’re some sort of homeless person who just wandered in that no one has bothered removing yet.
lines.zh: : 是吗?因为我常常觉得你是那种不知从哪儿晃进来的流浪汉,只是大家还没腾出手把你弄走。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m going to go to class now.
lines.zh: : 好,我现在要去上课了。

lines.en: : Look at you, doing your best to play the role of a teacher. How cute.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧你,正努力扮演着老师的角色呢。真可爱。

lines.en: : Anyway, if that’s all-
lines.zh: : 总之,如果没别的事——

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff7
: Wait.
lines.zh: : 等等。

lines.en: : What now? I already told you I’d tell Imani about your estrogen filled bar night.
lines.zh: : 又怎么了?我说过了,我会告诉 Imani 你那个充满雌激素的酒吧之夜。

lines.en: : This has nothing to do with estrogen.
lines.zh: : 这跟雌激素没关系。

lines.en: : I have no idea if that’s a good thing or a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这是好事还是坏事。

lines.en: : I was just wondering if you had any sort of interest in archery.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问问,你对弓道有没有兴趣。

lines.en: : That’s...a weird thing to wonder. And to plan on asking me about.
lines.zh: : 这是个……奇怪的好奇点。而且还特意打算来问我。

lines.en: : It {i}would{/i} be...if I was not the advisor for the school’s archery club.
lines.zh: : 如果不是学校弓道部的顾问是我,那{i}确实{/i}奇怪。

lines.en: : Am I being recruited right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在是在被招募吗?

lines.en: : Not necessarily. But I can’t exactly move the way I used to. So if you’re able to look after the club on occasion when I’m unable to, I’d greatly appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 也不完全是。只是我已经没办法像以前那样活动了。所以如果在我去不了的时候,你能偶尔替我照看一下社团,我会非常感激。

lines.en: : Are you really sure I’m older than you? Because between that and those permanent bags beneath your eyes, I’m beginning to have my doubts.
lines.zh: : 你真确定我比你大?就凭这个,还有你眼睛下面那两袋永久性的眼袋,我都开始怀疑了。

lines.en: : If you’re {i}not{/i} interested, could you at least do me one other favor?
lines.zh: : 如果你{i}没{/i}兴趣,至少能帮我另一个忙吗?

lines.en: : Does it involve estrogen?
lines.zh: : 跟雌激素有关吗?

lines.en: : It...actually does.
lines.zh: : 这……还真有。

lines.en: : Sure, Wakana. I’ll fuck your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 行啊,Wakana。我去睡你女朋友。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff8
: Oh please. You wouldn’t know the first thing about what she likes.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。她喜欢什么,你连第一样都摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Vaginas and handcuffs.
lines.zh: : 阴道和手铐。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t know the third or fourth things about what she likes.
lines.zh: : 她喜欢什么,你连第三样、第四样都摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : I can figure them out.
lines.zh: : 我可以自己摸索出来。

lines.en: : {i}Arakawa.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Arakawa。{/i}

lines.en: : Fine. What do you {i}actually{/i} want?
lines.zh: : 行吧。你{i}到底{/i}想要什么?

lines.en: : I want you to keep my role as the archery club advisor to yourself...because if a certain brown-haired genius found out about it and joined the club, I would be forced to resign.
lines.zh: : 我想请你替我保密——别说出我是弓道部顾问这件事……因为要是某个棕头发的天才知道了并加入社团,我就不得不辞职了。

lines.en: : Nodoka is {i}still{/i} bothering you?
lines.zh: : Nodoka {i}还{/i}在烦你?

lines.en: : That girl will chase me off the end of the sidewalk and into the abyss below.
lines.zh: : 那丫头会把我从人行道尽头一路追下去,追进下面的深渊。

lines.en: : Then sure. I'll keep your secret safe.
lines.zh: : 那好。我会替你守住这个秘密。

lines.en: : Thank-
: Under one condition.
lines.zh: : 有一个条件。

lines.en: : I will not allow you to bed my woman, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 我可不会允许你上我的女人,Arakawa。

lines.en: : I just want to know how old you are so we can settle this once and for all.
lines.zh: : 我只想知道你多大,好让我们一次性把这个了结。

lines.en: : And you’ll keep Nagasawa away if I tell you?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你,你会帮我挡住 Nagasawa?

lines.en: : I will...do my best.
lines.zh: : 我会……尽我所能。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff9
: Hah...
scene newsummerstuff5
: I’m 28 years old.
: God damnit. How do you look {i}that{/i} tired at 28 years old?
lines.zh: : 操。你 28 岁怎么就累成{i}这副样子{/i}?

lines.en: : Misery takes its toll on the body rather viciously.
lines.zh: : 痛苦对身体的摧残,可是相当狠的。

lines.en: : You’re only one year younger than my famous idol ex-girlfriend, Niki Nakayama.
lines.zh: : 你只比我那个著名偶像前女友 Niki Nakayama 小一岁。

lines.en: : Right. Your famous idol ex-girlfriend. I’ll be sure to tell my astronaut uncle and his panhandling capuchin monkey all about her.
lines.zh: : 对。你那个著名偶像前女友。我一定会把她的故事,原原本本讲给我那个当宇航员的叔叔,还有他那只讨饭的卷尾猴听。

lines.en: : I’m not joking. I really did-
lines.zh: : 我没开玩笑。我真的——

lines.en: : Goodbye, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 再见,Arakawa。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff1
: Oh, and if Miyamura is looking for a club to join, be sure to send her my way. A handful of your girls have already applied, so she wouldn’t be without friends.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,如果 Miyamura 正在找社团加入,记得把她推荐到我这儿来。你的好几个姑娘已经报名了,所以她不会没有朋友。

lines.en: : I’ll call Niki right now and-
lines.zh: : 我现在就给 Niki 打电话,然后——

lines.en: : Give it up. You aren’t fooling anyone.
lines.zh: : 省省吧。你骗不了任何人。

lines.en: : Wakana, wait-
lines.zh: : Wakana,等等——

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff10
: Yumi, you realize you’re literally the {i}only{/i} person still wearing the old uniform, right? You can wear whatever you want now.
lines.zh: : Yumi,你该知道你是全校{i}唯一{/i}还穿着旧校服的人了吧?现在你想穿什么就穿什么了。

lines.en: : You think I can afford a new one? You know I ain’t found a job yet.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我买得起新的吗?你知道我还没找到工作。

lines.en: : Yumi, they were literally free. I’m poor too, just in case you’ve forgotten.
lines.zh: : Yumi,那玩意儿是白送的。我也穷,怕你忘了提醒你一下。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff11
: Wait, you fuckin’ serious? How come you never told me?!
lines.zh: : 等等,你他妈认真的?你怎么从来没告诉过我?!

lines.en: : Imani told everybody like a hundred times. I’m pretty sure even Sensei said it once or twice.
lines.zh: : Imani 跟所有人说了大概一百遍了。我敢肯定连 Sensei 都说过一两次。

lines.en: : You know I don’t listen to adults! And you also know that I don’t even normally come here {i}to{/i} listen to them!
lines.zh: : 你知道我不听大人的话!而且你也知道,我平时根本就不来这儿{i}听他们说话{/i}!

lines.en: : In all fairness, neither of them are like {i}normal{/i} adults. So I think you’d be able to listen to them without ruining the badass delinquent persona thing you’ve got going on.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,他们俩都不像{i}正常{/i}的大人。所以我觉得你就算听他们的,也不至于毁掉你那副「硬派不良少女」的人设。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff12
: God fucking damn it. Pretty soon you’re going to tell me some other shit that’s going to ruin my school life too and-
lines.zh: : 我操。你很快就要再告诉我点别的什么、把我的校园生活也给毁了吧,而且——

lines.en: : You know you’ve also gotta sign up for a club by the end of the day, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道今天结束前你也得报一个社团吧?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff13
: What the fuck is going on today?!
lines.zh: : 今天他妈的到底是怎么回事?!

lines.en: : Relax, relax. I doubt you’ll ever have to show up or anything. It’s more of a...formality. Just sign up for something and go whenever you want to go. Which, knowing you...is never.
lines.zh: : 放松,放松。我怀疑你根本不用出席什么的。这更像是个……形式。随便报一个,想去的时候再去。而以我对你的了解……那就是永远不去。

lines.en: : I’ll just...sign up for whatever you sign up for. That way-
lines.zh: : 那我就……你报什么我报什么。这样——

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff14
: I don’t want you to be in the same club as me.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你跟我在同一个社团。

lines.en: : You...what? Why the fuck not?
lines.zh: : 你……什么?为什么他妈的不行?

lines.en: : A few reasons.
lines.zh: : 有几个理由。

lines.en: : First, if the two of us were in the same club and you actually decided to go to the meetings, it would make watching Chinami like, ten times harder since we wouldn’t be able to coordinate.
lines.zh: : 首先,如果我们俩在同一个社团,而你又真的打算去参加活动,那盯 Chinami 的难度就会高上十倍,因为我们没法分工。

lines.en: : Second, we already see each other like...75%% of every day.
lines.zh: : 其次,我们每天已经有 75%% 的时间都黏在一起了。

lines.en: : But third and most importantly...
lines.zh: : 但第三点,也是最重要的……

lines.en: : You’ve gotta leave the fucking nest, girl.
lines.zh: : 你得离开那个他妈的窝了,丫头。

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 那个……什么?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff15
: I mean you can’t just cling to me in social situations anymore! You’ve been taking baby steps, sure. Like...the whole apologizing to Futaba thing? That was awesome and I’m so proud of you.
lines.zh: : 我是说,你不能再在社交场合里一味黏着我了!你确实在一小步一小步地走。比如……跟 Futaba 道歉那件事?那太棒了,我真的为你骄傲。

lines.en: : But you still won’t even show up to any of our parties without me pushing you to come...and you always ask to see {i}my{/i} notes when there are tons of other people who’d love to help you.
lines.zh: : 可你还是每次都要我催才肯来参加我们的派对……而且明明有一大堆人乐意帮你,你却总是开口借{i}我的{/i}笔记。

lines.en: : Can’t you at least {i}try{/i} joining a club I’m not a part of? I can’t just be your fallback for everything, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你就不能至少{i}试试{/i}加入一个我不在的社团吗?我不能什么事都当你的退路,Yumi。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff16
: You’ve been hangin’ out with our fuckin’ schizoid teacher too much if even {i}you’re{/i} gonna start lecturin’ me like this now.
lines.zh: : 你一定是跟我们那个神经分裂的老师混太久了,连{i}你{/i}都开始这么教训我了。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to lecture you! I’m trying to be a good friend.
lines.zh: : 我不是在教训你!我是想当个好朋友。

lines.en: : I love you, but I just...don’t want you living in my shadow anymore.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,但我只是……不想你再活在我的影子里了。

lines.en: : I want you to pay attention to announcements...I want you to come to school and take your own notes...I want you to choose your own club.
lines.zh: : 我希望你留意各种通知……我希望你来上学、自己记笔记……我希望你自己选社团。

lines.en: : Yeah. But you’re forgettin’ the part where {i}I don’t wanna do any of that shit.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。可你忘了一点——{i}那些事我他妈一件都不想做{/i}。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff17
: Forgetting? Or {i}ignoring?{/i}
lines.zh: : 忘了?还是{i}装没看见{/i}?

lines.en: : Oh, suck my dick.
lines.zh: : 哦,去舔我的鸡巴吧。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff18
: Guess you’ve got a point, though. I just...ain’t really good at all that social shit. And I don’t even know what fuckin’ clubs we {i}have{/i} here.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得倒是有道理。我只是……真的不擅长那些社交的破事。而且我他妈连这儿{i}有{/i}什么社团都不知道。

lines.en: : I’m sure Makoto has a list if you want to go talk to her.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意去找她,Makoto 那儿肯定有清单。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure she does too. But that would involve actually talkin’ to Makoto and I ain’t ready for that shit yet.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我肯定她有。可那得真的去跟 Makoto 说话,而我还没准备好面对那种事。

lines.en: : The fuck club are {i}you{/i} even joinin’ anyway? I ain’t ever heard you mention {i}shit{/i} about clubs until today.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}他妈到底要加入什么社团?今天之前我可从没听你提过{i}一个字{/i}。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter what {i}I’m{/i} doing. Just choose one for yourself and, if it actually winds up being the same one I’m in, I {i}guess{/i} I can maybe...rethink being apart from you.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}做什么不重要。你自己选一个就好,如果最后真跟我选了同一个,那我{i}大概{/i}可以……重新考虑一下要不要跟你分开。

lines.en: : But I’m not telling you which one I chose because I know it’ll impact your decision.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会告诉你我选了哪个,因为我知道那会影响你的决定。

lines.en: : Fucking damn it. This sucks.
lines.zh: : 操。真他妈糟。

lines.en: : Yeah. Life sure is hard, huh?
lines.zh: : 是啊。人生真难啊,嗯?

lines.en: : Was pretty okay until you decided you were gonna go all...whatever the fuck {i}this{/i} is on me.
lines.zh: : 本来还挺好的,直到你决定对我来{i}这{/i}一套……管它他妈的叫什么。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff19
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 嗯,那个……

lines.en: : There’s somebody I want to look good in front of now. Which means I don’t have all the time in the world to worry about looking out for {i}you{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在我有了想在她面前显得好看的人。也就是说,我没有那么多闲工夫再一门心思照顾{i}你{/i}了。

lines.en: : I’ll obvs still have your back if anything goes down, but...for the most part, I want you to do your own thing so {i}I{/i} can do mine.
lines.zh: : 真出了事{i}我{/i}当然还是会挺你的,不过……大体上,我希望你忙你的,我好忙我的。

lines.en: : I can handle Chinami. But another bigger, meaner Chinami on {i}top{/i} of Chinami? Yeah, that I don’t have the time for right now.
lines.zh: : 一个 Chinami 我应付得来。可是在 Chinami {i}之上{/i}再来一个更大、更凶的 Chinami?那个我现在可没时间应付。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Sounds like a huge fuckin’ Chinami.
lines.zh: : 听起来就像一坨他妈的巨大 Chinami。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff20
: For your sake, I really hope whatever club you join doesn’t involve comedy.
lines.zh: : 为了你好,我真希望你要加入的那个社团跟喜剧没关系。

lines.en: scene black
scene newsummerstuff21
: Yasu! You simply {i}have{/i} to join the kyudo club with me!
lines.zh: : Yasu!你{i}一定得{/i}跟我一起加入弓道部!

lines.en: : I understand that your arms may be too weak to properly handle a bow, but I’ve already consulted my mother and she’s agreed to hire an entire team of physical trainers to help fix that!
lines.zh: : 我知道你的手臂也许太弱,拿不稳弓,但我已经问过我母亲了,她同意雇一整支体能教练团队来帮你解决这个问题!

lines.en: : Doesn’t that sound wonderful? You and I could be together for all hours of the day!
lines.zh: : 听起来是不是很棒?那样你和我就能一天到晚都在一起了!

lines.en: : He doesn’t like weapons.
lines.zh: : 他不喜欢武器。

lines.en: : He? Who is he? Are you referring to Sensei? Because if you’d like to ask him for permission directly, I’d-
lines.zh: : 他?他是谁?你是指 Sensei 吗?如果你想直接去征求他的同意,我可以——

lines.en: : He who sees but doesn’t. That which lurks. The one with many eyes.
lines.zh: : 那看见却看不见的他。潜伏着的那一位。长着许多眼睛的那一位。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff22
: Oh. {i}Him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦。是{i}他{/i}啊。

lines.en: : The path I must follow is a righteous one without bloodshed or violence.
lines.zh: : 我必须走的,是一条没有流血、没有暴力的正义之路。

lines.en: : Man is not responsible enough to bear the power of God. And for that reason, we must never take up arms.
lines.zh: : 人类还不够有担当,承受不起神的力量。正因如此,我们绝不能拿起武器。

lines.en: : My frailty has naught to do with it. I am simply trying to live a life free of sin.
lines.zh: : 这与我的虚弱毫无关系。我只是想活一个没有罪孽的人生。

lines.en: : Summer has come, dearest Touka. He is all around us. Watching our every move. Judging our every decision.
lines.zh: : 夏天来了,亲爱的 Touka。他就在我们四周。注视着我们的一举一动。审判着我们的每一个决定。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. He sounds quite wonderful, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 是是是。听起来他真了不起,Yasu。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff23
: But do you know who else is wonderful?! Henmi Kiyomitsu, the creator of Kyūjutsu! And to think that it dates all the way back to the Heian period is just spectacular and-
lines.zh: : 可你知道还有谁很了不起吗?!Henmi Kiyomitsu,弓术的创始人!而且想想它居然能一路追溯到平安时代,简直太壮观了,而且——

lines.en: : The one who awakens dates back to before time itself and could swallow Henmi Kiyomitsu whole.
lines.zh: : 那位「苏醒者」的历史可以追溯到时间本身之前,他能一口把 Henmi Kiyomitsu 整个吞下去。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff24
: Wait...does your god...{i}eat{/i} people? Is that what makes him so wonderful?
lines.zh: : 等等……你的神……{i}吃{/i}人吗?就是因为这个他才这么了不起?

lines.en: : God would never do such a thing.
lines.zh: : 神绝不会做那种事。

lines.en: : But He could.
lines.zh: : 但他做得到。

lines.en: : It is His resistance and humbleness and the way He favors love before all else that makes Him so wonderful.
lines.zh: : 是他的克制、他的谦卑,还有他把爱放在一切之上的方式,让他如此了不起。

lines.en: : And if He asks that I do not lay my hands on a weapon, I must follow His guidance.
lines.zh: : 如果他要求我不要碰武器,我就必须遵从他的指引。

lines.en: : But...Yasu...you do realize that this decision will lead to us being apart, do you not?
lines.zh: : 可是……Yasu……你该明白这个决定会导致我们分开吧?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff25
: Forever?...
lines.zh: : 永远分开?……

lines.en: : What? No. Not forever. Just for the duration of club.
lines.zh: : 什么?不是。不是永远。只是在社团活动的那段时间。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff26
: I have already accepted that I will be with you always and forever and that, in the most humane way possible, you are a living doll that I am free to mold into a real, live human girl.
lines.zh: : 我已经接受了,我会永远、永远跟你在一起;而且,以尽可能人道的方式来说,你是一个活着的人偶,我可以随心把你塑造成一个真正的、活生生的女孩。

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. I have always dreamed of being a real, live human girl.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Touka。我一直梦想着成为一个真正的、活生生的女孩。

lines.en: : They all smell so nice and breathe so quietly.
lines.zh: : 她们闻起来都那么好闻,呼吸都那么安静。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, even with your guidance and His, I am still but the lowliest and flattest of worms. My existence here, while purposeful, is not enough to leave a mark on anyone but you.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是,即便有你的指引和他的指引,我依然只是一只最卑微、最扁平的蠕虫。我在这里的存在虽然有意义,却不足以在你之外的任何人身上留下痕迹。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not true at all! In fact, Sana seems to be quite terrified of you! And while that isn’t exactly a {i}good{/i} thing, it still means that you have left a mark!
lines.zh: : 哎,这可完全不对!事实上,Sana 看起来就很怕你!虽然那算不上什么{i}好{/i}事,但至少说明你还是留下了痕迹!

lines.en: : Will I be rewarded when I switch planes?
lines.zh: : 等我切换到另一个位面时,我会得到奖赏吗?

lines.en: : I’m not sure what this talk about planes is, but if that is what you are after, I’d be delighted to show you my family’s private jet after school today.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白你们说的位面是什么,不过如果那就是你想要的,我很乐意今天放学后带你去看看我家的私人飞机。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff27
: Yes! Bring me closer to the sky so I can see the light!
lines.zh: : 好!带我更靠近天空,好让我看见那道光!

lines.en: : Okay! I’ll make some calls momentarily, but the jet has been grounded ever since Kumon-mi was isolated, so I’m not sure if we’ll be able to take off or not.
lines.zh: : 好!我这就去打几个电话,不过自从 Kumon-mi 被隔离之后,那架飞机就一直停飞了,所以我不确定我们能不能起飞。

lines.en: : Just being inside thick walls of metal is enough to make me feel closer to Him!
lines.zh: : 光是待在厚厚的金属墙壁里,就足以让我觉得自己离他更近了!

lines.en: : I’ll say, your religion really is quite modern, isn’t it? I’ve never heard anything quite like that before.
lines.zh: : 我得说,你的宗教还真是相当现代,不是吗?我以前从没听过类似的东西。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff28
: If you heard the things I heard, you’d hear everything everywhere all at once.
lines.zh: : 如果你听见了我听见的东西,你就会在同一瞬间,听见一切地方的一切。

lines.en: : I do wonder just what club you {i}will{/i} join then if not kyudo.
lines.zh: : 我倒是好奇,如果不加入弓道部,你到底{i}会{/i}加入什么社团。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff23
: I’m sure you’ll do just fine, though! Everyone will love you once they see the real you!
lines.zh: : 不过我相信你一定会做得很好的!等大家看到真正的你,一定会都爱上你的!

lines.en: : Do you remember the advice I gave you, Yasu? Because you’ll need to follow it very closely in order to succeed in life.
lines.zh: : 还记得我给你的建议吗,Yasu?因为你要想在人生里混出点名堂,就得牢牢照着它做。

lines.en: : I do!
lines.zh: : 记得!

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑!

lines.en: : That’s exactly right! Remember to smile! For, if you don’t-
lines.zh: : 完全正确!记得微笑!因为,如果你不——

lines.en: scene happy3
scene happy4
scene happy5
scene newsummerstuff29
: Kendo Princess of...wherever we designated as your place of origin is!
lines.zh: : 来自……我们随便给你指定的那个原籍的剑道公主!

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen, home of the noodle.
lines.zh: : Tojo 拉面,面条之家。

lines.en: : That was...definitely not it! But that is not what matters right now!
lines.zh: : 那……绝对不是!不过现在重要的不是这个!

lines.en: : That’s right! What matters is that you, Tsuneyo Tojo, join {i}us-{/i}
lines.zh: : 没错!重要的是,你,Tsuneyo Tojo,加入{i}我们{/i}——

lines.en: : Molly and Ami! President and peon!
lines.zh: : Molly 和 Ami!部长和小喽啰!

lines.en: : In the school’s manga club!
lines.zh: : 加入学校的漫画部!

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff30
: Now, I know what you must be thinking. But for the purpose of this sales pitch, I will now have Ami read your mind. Ami, go!
lines.zh: : 现在,我知道你在想什么。不过为了这场推销,我现在要让 Ami 来读你的心。Ami,上!

lines.en: : Noodles.
lines.zh: : 面条。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff31
: Get out of my head! The Tojo family’s secret recipes are in there!
lines.zh: : 从我的脑子里滚出去!Tojo 家的秘方都在里面!

lines.en: : Read the other thing, Ami! Not the noodle part!
lines.zh: : 读另一样,Ami!别读面条那部分!

lines.en: : Right, right...umm...uhh...it’s a little blurry, but...I think it’s saying...{i}I want to join the manga club!{/i}
lines.zh: : 对,对……呃……嗯……有点模糊,不过……我觉得它在说……{i}我想加入漫画部!{/i}

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff32
: The girl with the nice legs knows my thoughts before even I do. How can this be?
lines.zh: : 那个腿很好看的女孩,居然比我更早知道我的心思。这怎么可能?

lines.en: : You see, Kendo Princess...the manga club isn’t {i}all{/i} about manga...it is about companionship! Camaraderie! Cosplay! But most importantly...
lines.zh: : 你瞧,剑道公主……漫画部不{i}只{/i}是关于漫画……它关乎陪伴!关乎友情!关乎角色扮演!但最重要的是……

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff33
: It’s about comparing ships and then arguing with each other about it!
lines.zh: : 它关乎比拼「CP」,然后为此互相争论!

lines.en: : Precisely!
lines.zh: : 正是!

lines.en: : I have heard of this. I believe that is called a “yacht club.”
lines.zh: : 这个我听说过。我想那应该叫「游艇俱乐部」吧。

lines.en: : Not that kind of ship, Kendo Princess! The kind with two characters who are meant to be together!
lines.zh: : 不是那种船,剑道公主!是那种两个角色注定要在一起的组合!

lines.en: : As long as they are able to put aside their feelings while on the job, I am sure everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要他们在工作时能把感情放到一边,我相信一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : But why do you want me in your yacht club? I know nothing about boats {i}or{/i} manga.
lines.zh: : 可你们为什么想让我加入你们的游艇俱乐部?我对船{i}和{/i}漫画一窍不通。

lines.en: : Not yet, you don’t! But you have been trying and that is all that matters!
lines.zh: : 现在不懂,以后就懂了!而且你一直在尝试,这才是最重要的!

lines.en: : You see, manga club isn’t some elitist group of girls who will tell you what to watch and when-
lines.zh: : 你瞧,漫画部可不是那种会告诉你该看什么、什么时候看的精英小团体——

lines.en: : It’s a group of nerds who love nerd stuff and want to act like nerds in the same room as {i}other{/i} nerds without being judged!
lines.zh: : 它是一群喜欢宅物、想跟{i}别的{/i}宅一起在同一个房间里当宅、还不用被指指点点的宅!

lines.en: : It’s a group of great friends who support each other and cheer each other on when things get bad!
lines.zh: : 它是一群在日子变糟时互相支持、互相打气的好朋友!

lines.en: : It’s a group where we are all unified in one thing! The belief that One Piece has too many episodes!
lines.zh: : 它是一个在一件事上空前团结的团体!那就是坚信《海贼王》的集数实在太多了!

lines.en: : And a group where, no matter how hard I try, I can’t get anyone to watch Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure with me!
lines.zh: : 也是一个不管我怎么努力,都找不到人陪我看《JOJO的奇妙冒险》的团体!

lines.en: : Hey, I watched the whole first season with you, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嘿,第一季我可是陪你全看完了,不是吗?

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff34
: Sure, I never kept going after that since it definitely wasn’t my cup of tea...but I tried, you know?
lines.zh: : 是啊,之后我就没再往下看了,因为那确实完全不合我的口味……可我试过了啊,你懂的?

lines.en: : {i}Tsuneyo, this is the kind of ship we were talking about just now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Tsuneyo,我们刚才说的就是这种「船」。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh no. I forgot to buy a ticket.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我忘了买票。

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff35
: Can we talk?
lines.zh: : 我们能谈谈吗?

lines.en: : I don’t think it’ll take long, but...there are a few things I need to say and...well, I kind of need to say them before the day is over.
lines.zh: : 我想不会太久,不过……有几件事我必须说,而且……嗯,我得在今天结束之前把它们说出来。

lines.en: : You...want to talk to {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……想跟{i}我{/i}谈谈?

lines.en: : Do you really think I would have done something as awkward and uncomfortable as this if I didn’t?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得,如果我不是想谈,会干出这么尴尬、这么难受的事吗?

lines.en: : I obviously know shit’s weird for us right now and-
lines.zh: : 我当然知道我们现在的关系很怪,而且——

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff36
: And, uhh...
lines.zh: : 而且,呃……

lines.en: : Umm...
: Actually...can we do this outside? Sensei won't care if we leave and...it’s not really something that I want other people listening in on.
lines.zh: : 其实……我们能出去谈吗?我们走掉 Sensei 不会在意的,而且……这事我真不太想让别人听见。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah.
: Yeah, we can talk. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我们可以谈。没问题。

lines.en: : Can it be in the shade, though? The summer sun is cruel to this Irish skin and getting into spandex with sunburn is a horrible experience that I do not want to relive.
lines.zh: : 不过能不能找个阴凉的地方?夏天的太阳对我这身爱尔兰皮肤很残忍,而带着晒伤钻进氨纶里,是一种我不想再经历一遍的糟糕体验。

lines.en: scene newsummerstuff37
: Yeah...I’m sure we can find somewhere with shade...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们肯定能找到有阴凉的地方……
